# routeros_interface_ethernet_poe_monitor (Data Source)
Read `/interface/ethernet/poe/monitor` on RouterOS 7.25.1+. [CLI reference](https://manual.mikrotik.com/docs/7.25/cli-reference/interface/ethernet/poe/monitor/).

## Example Usage
```terraform
# RouterOS 7.25.1+. Requires the corresponding hardware/package.
data "routeros_interface_ethernet_poe_monitor" "example" {
  arguments = {
    numbers = "ether5"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `arguments` (Map of String, Sensitive) Command selectors, such as `.id` or `numbers`. The command runs only to read operational status.

### Read-Only

- `data` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
